priority: Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s without MTP

source.analysis_subject: bench: reject Decode GDN transient register state

format.name: P15E-T128-v1
format.roundtrip: bit exact for every raw E4M3 code in all 128 tensors

per_tensor_palette_scan.palette_policy: stable top-15 raw codes per tensor, frequency descending then raw value ascending

palette_scope_comparison.selected_for_test_only_decoder_screen: one shared palette per layer gate/up pair

optimistic_traffic_projection.classification: byte-only upper bound before nibble unpack, palette lookup, ballot/rank, escape addressing, sparse loads, metadata, and cache effects

performance_risk.interpretation: Even granting the new representation its extra byte saving at zero cost leaves most prior scale6 regression unresolved. P15E-T128 must therefore pass an isolated same-binary decoder/sector stop-loss before any full gate/up kernel is written.

next_gate.scope: same-binary canonical, scale6, and P15E-T128 decoder/sector microbenchmark using actual checkpoint distributions
next_gate.stop_loss: If the decoder cannot preserve enough of the 4.6875-us/layer budget, remove it without adding a production descriptor or dispatch.

reproduction.runtime: python3 plus numpy; safetensors payloads are read directly and encoded only in process memory
reproduction.algorithm: For every gate/up scale tensor, build a stable top-15 palette; transpose raw bytes into current kernel consumption order; encode two nibbles per byte; store a uint32 prefix for each 128-value tile and raw escapes in encounter order; decode and transpose back; require byte-for-byte source equality.
reproduction.safetensors_offset_rule: the first eight bytes are a little-endian U64 header length; each tensor data offset is relative to byte 8 + header_length

claim_limits: This record admits only encoded capacity. It reports no CUDA decoder timing, full gate/up timing, end-to-end timing, or achieved speedup.
Canonical scale tensors remain required by Prefill and fallback routes; the sidecar would be additional resident memory rather than a model-memory saving.
The 1.897253-ms/token value assumes every saved byte translates linearly at 165.567 GB/s and all decoding is free. It is an optimistic screening ceiling.
Only the palette and current layer directory are small enough to consider for L2 persistence; the roughly 399-MB full sidecar cannot persist in the 2.75-MiB window.
MTP is explicitly excluded from this candidate and the current target path.
